title: AdaWorld: Learning Adaptable World Models with Latent Actions
author: Shenyuan Gao; Siyuan Zhou; Yilun Du; Jun Zhang; Chuang Gan
summary: AdaWorld is a new world model that learns actions from videos without needing expensive labels. It uses latent actions to transfer and adapt behaviors across different environments easily. This method improves planning and works well even with limited training in new settings.
